definitions.ask: With 10+ choices and no stage open, should the first digit open the choices stage filtered to it?
definitions.why: One key sequence everywhere, and the filtered list shows what the next digit can reach

choices.label: First digit opens the choices filtered to that prefix; the second digit picks and saves
Stage stays closed; the status line shows the pending prefix until the second digit saves
Browse keeps today's 1–9 instant pick; two-digit codes work only inside the choices stage

definitions.ask: With 10+ choices, should digit badges be zero-padded to the code width (01…17)?
definitions.why: The badge is the code you type, so nothing has to be guessed

choices.label: Badges show exactly what you type (01, 07, 17), so the column lines up
Badges show 1…17 as today; choices 1–9 still need a leading 0 that badges don't show
